app.name: Petra Issue Tracker
app.tagline: A clear view of the work that needs attention.

nav.importHint: Loads the issues of this release into the portal; safe to repeat.

login.title: Sign in to Petra Tracker
login.description: Sign in with GitHub. New here? Your account asks for access and an administrator decides.
login.notAllowed: This GitHub account has not been added or is inactive. Ask an administrator for access.

dashboard.title: Issue overview
dashboard.description: Review the work queue and open an issue to add an update.
dashboard.adminView: All tracked issues, across the frontend and backend teams.
dashboard.developerView: Only issues assigned to your account are shown.
dashboard.denied: You can only update issues assigned to your account.
dashboard.bulkDone: {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} assigned.
dashboard.bulkNone: Tick at least one issue (up to 200 at a time).
dashboard.bulkInvalid: Choose an active developer, or Unassigned.
dashboard.selectAll: Select all issues on this page
dashboard.archiveHint: Closed issues nobody has touched for 2 days, and issues archived by hand. A comment, status change or assignment brings an issue back to the list.
dashboard.importHint: Loads the issues of this release into the portal; safe to repeat.
dashboard.importDone: Catalogue imported: {added} new, {moved} moved by the code check, {kept} kept as set by a person.
dashboard.importFailed: The catalogue could not be imported. Check the database settings.
dashboard.reviewAsked: {name} asks to move this from {from} to {to}.

issue.archiveNowInfo: Closed work leaves the list after 2 days on its own; archive it now to move it at once.
issue.archiveInfo: This issue is in the archive. Restoring puts it back in the list.
issue.archiveNeedsClosed: Only a fixed or won't-fix issue can be archived.
issue.noActivity: No comments yet. Add the first update below.
issue.commentPlaceholder: Explain what changed or why this issue will not be implemented.
issue.closureNote: A comment is required with every update. Explain business logic or why work will not proceed when choosing Won't fix.
issue.notFound: This issue could not be found or is not assigned to you.
issue.conflict: This issue changed while you were editing. Reload it and try again.
issue.invalid: Enter a comment and choose a valid status.
issue.reasonNeeded: Won't fix needs a reason of at least 20 characters: say which business rule applies or why the work will not proceed.
issue.requested: Your request was sent. The status changes only after an administrator approves it.
issue.decidedApproved: Request approved: the status was changed.
issue.rejectReasonNeeded: Say why the request is rejected.
issue.pendingTitle: Status request waiting for your decision
issue.pendingBy: {name} asks to change the status to “{status}”.
issue.decisionNotePlaceholder: Why, or what to do next
issue.yourRequestWaiting: Your request for “{status}” is waiting for an administrator.
issue.requestHint: A status you choose here is a request: an administrator decides. A comment alone needs no approval.

access.waitingTitle: Your request is with an administrator
access.waitingBody: You signed in with GitHub, and your account has asked for access. An administrator will approve it; then sign in again.
access.declinedBody: An administrator declined this account. Ask them if you think that is a mistake.
access.disabledBody: An administrator deactivated this account. Ask them to switch it on.

drawer.loadError: The issue could not be loaded. Close this panel and try again.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Add GitHub accounts and manage who can access the tracker.
developers.name: Name
developers.added: Developer added. They can now sign in with the matching GitHub account.
developers.alreadyExists: A tracker account already uses that email.
developers.invalid: Enter a valid name and email.
developers.requestsHint: People who signed in with GitHub and asked for access. Nobody gets in until you approve.
developers.accessApproved: Access approved. They can sign in now.
developers.makeAdminHint: Can then assign issues, approve or reject status requests and manage people. Keeps their own assigned issues.
developers.removeAdminHint: Back to a developer: sees only the issues assigned to them.
developers.notYourself: You can't change your own role or access.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
